keyword: Care for your circle and yourself
lead: 66 is read as a sign about love, home and responsibility. It doubles the 6 of care and family, and its root is 3 (6+6 = 12, 1+2 = 3), the number of joy. The reading: caring for others works best when it does not cost you all your own lightness.
love: If you are single: 66 favours someone who values family and home life. It is also a reminder to treat yourself with the care you would give a partner. If you are in a relationship: 66 points to warmth and shared responsibility. If one of you has been carrying more, it is a cue to rebalance.
career: 66 suits caring and creative work, such as health, teaching, hospitality and design for homes. With money, it favours spending on what truly supports your household.
steps: Do one small thing for someone at home today.
Ask for help with one thing you usually do alone.
Make time for something that simply makes you laugh.
